register_completion_template: register a FIM completion template with begin, middle, and end tokens for a code model
generate_completion_prompt: generate a code completion prompt by wrapping prompt and suffix with FIM template tokens
generate_completion_prompt_from_request: generate a code completion prompt from an OpenAI CompletionRequest object using the active template
set_completion_template: set the active completion template name for subsequent prompt generation
completion_template_exists: check whether a completion template with the given name has been registered
